title: Super Tenere 1200
description: Representing Yamaha's prowess in the Adventure Tourer class, the Yamaha Super Tenere 1200 is delivers all-weather long-haul versatility with long-travel suspension compliance. A 1200cc powerplant pumps out 150 HP and 120 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
